ffWelcomeTitle: You're in! Your first payment is platform-fee-free
ffWelcomeBody: Welcome to Dynopay. We waive our full platform fee on your very first payment — any size — so every cent goes straight to your wallet. You only ever pay the network (blockchain) cost. After that, fees start at just 1.5% and drop as you grow.
ffWelcomeFootnote: The platform fee is waived automatically on your first payment.

v3.headTitle: Fees · Dynopay — From 0.5% flat, no monthly, no chargebacks.
v3.heroSubtitle: No monthly fee. No setup fee. No chargebacks. You only pay when you get paid — and the more you move, the less it costs.
v3.tiersTitle: Four tiers. One number that shrinks.
v3.calcTitle: Move the slider. See your fee.
v3.sec1Body: Dynopay never holds your funds. Every settlement is a direct on-chain transfer to the wallet address you control — keep the coin you're paid in, or auto-convert to a stablecoin, your choice.
v3.sec2Body: Country-aware compliance built in. Users in regulated jurisdictions get gated at the right moment — no over-collection.
v3.sec3Body: Encrypted secrets in Google KMS, PII minimised, audit trail retained. Export or delete on request.
